systems.name: CBSA EDI / eManifest / CERS
systems.status_detail: CBSA publishes an annual calendar of scheduled maintenance dates for EDI, eManifest and CERS portal clients; exact outage times are communicated by bulletin.

events.title: CBSA scheduled maintenance date window
events.summary: CBSA lists September 12 to 13, 2026 as a scheduled maintenance window for EDI, eManifest and CERS portal clients. Exact outage times are communicated by bulletin closer to the event.
events.operational_impact: EDI, eManifest and CERS users should plan for possible service interruption during the published date window. The monthly calendar is not treated as proof of a continuous outage across the full dates.
events.workaround: Monitor CBSA Commercial Client Bulletins for exact timing and use the CBSA System Outage Contingency Plan if an outage affects cargo movement.
events.source_name: Canada Border Services Agency — Scheduled outages
